  "method": "Custom Monte Carlo simulation of photon transport in a water phantom. Cross sections for Compton (Klein-Nishina), pair production, photoelectric and Rayleigh scattering are interpolated from NIST data. Source photons (1.1732 and 1.3325 MeV, equal probability) are emitted from a point at SSD 100 cm into a 10x10 cm^2 field. Photons are tracked through the phantom; free paths follow exponential distributions. After each interaction, Compton and Rayleigh photons are followed further.
